label: H.Con.Res. 96
title: Expressing support for law enforcement officers.

items.snippet: This concurrent resolution expresses support for law enforcement officers.
It also appreciates the contributions and recognizes the sacrifices of law enforcement officers.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
